```{r setup}
source("utils.R")
source("config_load.R")

DATE_ACTION <- "20261016"
DATE_STR    <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

# Local git repo root — demographics/counting data is version-controlled here
# rather than living in L:/derivatives, since it's a frozen snapshot of raw
# questionnaire data (cleaned of unnecessary columns) rather than a
# regenerated pipeline output.
LOCAL_ROOT <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Passive/raw/participant_records/experiment_log"
DEMO_ROOT  <- LOCAL_ROOT

# L: drive — action score CSV + output derivatives, matching rest of pipeline
BEHAV_ROOT     <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Passive/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/behavior/"
OUTPUT_RESULTS <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Passive/derivatives_v2/outputs/stats/load/behavior/"



dir.create(OUTPUT_RESULTS, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

included_participants <- INCLUDED_PASSIVE
n <- length(included_participants)

cat(glue("Included passive participants: {n}\n"))
```

## Overview

```{r overview}
cat(glue(
"**Paper**: LOAD — Counting Accuracy (Passive Fixation Task)
**Paradigm**: PASSIVE only
**Task**: Participants counted flickers of the fixation cross during two oddball blocks
**Analysis**: (1) block difference, (2) accuracy plot, (3) correlation with action score
**N participants**: {n}
**Rendered**: {DATE_STR}
"))
```

```{r load-data}
library(readxl)

# Demographics / raw counts — from local git repo
df_summary <- read_excel(
  file.path(DEMO_ROOT, "3_data_summary_passive.xlsx"),
  skip = 1
)

df_filtered <- df_summary %>%
  filter(`Participant ID` %in% included_participants) %>%
  mutate(
    count2_clean = as.numeric(count2),
    count3_clean = as.numeric(count3)
  )

# Action score — from L: drive
df_action <- read.csv(
  file.path(BEHAV_ROOT, glue("{DATE_ACTION}_passive_action_score.csv"))
) %>%
  filter(participant %in% included_participants) %>%
  select(participant, action_past_hours)

cat(glue("N with demographics: {n_distinct(df_filtered[['Participant ID']])}\n"))
cat(glue("N with action score: {n_distinct(df_action$participant)}\n"))
```

## Data Preparation

```{r prepare-long}
CONDITIONS <- c("Oddball 1", "Oddball 2")
CORRECT    <- c("Oddball 1" = 15, "Oddball 2" = 19)

df_plot <- df_filtered %>%
  select(`Participant ID`, count2_clean, count3_clean) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(count2_clean, count3_clean),
    names_to  = "block",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(count)) %>%
  mutate(
    block     = recode(block, count2_clean = "Oddball 1", count3_clean = "Oddball 2"),
    block     = factor(block, levels = CONDITIONS),
    correct   = CORRECT[block],
    pct_error = (count - correct) / correct * 100
  )

n_valid <- n_distinct(df_plot$`Participant ID`)
cat(glue("N with at least one valid block: {n_valid}\n"))
```

## Block Difference (Oddball 1 vs Oddball 2)

```{r block-difference}
paired_wide <- df_plot %>%
  select(`Participant ID`, block, pct_error) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = block, values_from = pct_error) %>%
  drop_na()

n_paired <- nrow(paired_wide)

block_ttest <- paired_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(CONDITIONS), names_to = "block", values_to = "pct_error") %>%
  t_test(pct_error ~ block, paired = TRUE) %>%
  add_significance()

knitr::kable(block_ttest, digits = 4,
             caption = glue("Paired t-test, Oddball 1 vs Oddball 2 (N = {n_paired})"))
```

## Figure: Counting Accuracy Across Blocks

```{r fig-counting-blocks}
#| fig-cap: "Counting accuracy (signed % error) across Oddball 1 and Oddball 2 blocks."

p_blocks <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = block, y = pct_error)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "#3498DB", trim = TRUE, cut = 0) +
  geom_line(aes(group = `Participant ID`),
            color = "#2C3E50", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(color = "#2C3E50", alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.35, y = 0, label = "perfect count", size = 3.2, hjust = 0) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Signed % error ((reported \u2212 actual) / actual \u00d7 100)",
    title = glue("Oddball counting accuracy \u2014 Passive | N={n_valid}")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = margin(5.5, 40, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

print(p_blocks)

```

## Correlation with Action Score

```{r correlation-action}
df_pooled <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(`Participant ID`) %>%
  summarise(pct_error = mean(pct_error, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(
    df_action %>% rename(`Participant ID` = participant, action_score = action_past_hours),
    by = "Participant ID"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(action_score)

n_pooled <- nrow(df_pooled)

# Full sample
corr_full <- df_pooled %>% cor_test(action_score, pct_error, method = "spearman")

# Excluding S45 — highest action score (45.5h), exactly 0% error; single
# high-leverage point that changes significance (see manuscript note)
df_pooled_excl <- df_pooled %>% filter(`Participant ID` != "S45")
corr_excl <- df_pooled_excl %>% cor_test(action_score, pct_error, method = "spearman")

knitr::kable(bind_rows(
  corr_full %>% mutate(sample = glue("Full (N={n_pooled})")),
  corr_excl %>% mutate(sample = glue("Excl. S45 (N={nrow(df_pooled_excl)})"))
) %>% select(sample, everything()), digits = 4,
  caption = "Spearman correlation: action score vs. pooled signed % error")
```

## Figure: Correlation with Action Score

```{r fig-correlation-action}
#| fig-cap: "Counting accuracy vs. action-game experience score, full sample and with the single high-leverage participant (S45) excluded."

p_corr <- ggplot(df_pooled, aes(x = action_score, y = pct_error)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "#2C3E50") +
  geom_point(data = filter(df_pooled, `Participant ID` == "S45"),
             color = "#E74C3C", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#3498DB", fill = "#AED6F1") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = "Action score (est. weekly hours)",
    y = "Signed % error (pooled across blocks)",
    title = "Counting accuracy vs. action-game experience",
    subtitle = glue(
      "Full: rho={round(corr_full$cor, 3)}, p={round(corr_full$p, 4)} | ",
      "Excl. S45: rho={round(corr_excl$cor, 3)}, p={round(corr_excl$p, 4)}"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_corr)

```

## Manuscript Text Block

```{r apa-block, results='asis'}
block_p       <- format_p(block_ttest$p)
corr_full_p   <- format_p(corr_full$p)
corr_excl_p   <- format_p(corr_excl$p)

apa_text <- glue(
"**Counting accuracy (passive fixation task)**

Counting accuracy did not differ between the two oddball blocks ",
"(paired t-test, t = {round(block_ttest$statistic, 2)}, {block_p}, N = {n_paired}), ",
"justifying pooling of the two blocks for subsequent analysis.

Counting accuracy (expressed as signed percent error relative to the correct count) ",
"was not related to action-game experience score after removing a single high-leverage ",
"participant (Spearman correlation, excluding S45: rho = {round(corr_excl$cor, 3)}, {corr_excl_p}, N = {nrow(df_pooled_excl)}). ",
"The full-sample correlation (rho = {round(corr_full$cor, 3)}, {corr_full_p}, N = {n_pooled}) ",
"was not robust to this single exclusion."
)

cat(apa_text)
```

## Save Summary

```{r save-summary}
summary_df <- tibble(
  analysis = c("Block difference (Oddball 1 vs 2)",
               "Correlation, full sample",
               "Correlation, excl. S45"),
  statistic = c(block_ttest$statistic, corr_full$statistic, corr_excl$statistic),
  p_value   = c(block_ttest$p, corr_full$p, corr_excl$p),
  n         = c(n_paired, n_pooled, nrow(df_pooled_excl))
)

write.csv(summary_df,
          file.path(OUTPUT_RESULTS,
                    glue("passive_load_counting_summary_{DATE_STR}.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

knitr::kable(summary_df, digits = 4, caption = "Summary of counting accuracy analyses")
```
